name: fn-ptr-sret-mismatch-fix
description: Function pointer indirect calls missing sret convention for struct returns (MIR codegen only)

## Bug: fn ptr calls skip sret for struct returns (2026-03-19, FIXED)

**File**: `compiler/src/codegen/mir/instructions.cpp`, `emit_indirect_call` (~line 1566)

**Root cause**: `emit_indirect_call` generated by-value return calls (`call %struct.Response %fn_ptr(...)`) but the callee had been converted to sret convention by `SretConversionPass` (`define void @callee(ptr sret(...) %sret, ...)`). This caused stack corruption / segfault at runtime.

**Fix**: Added sret detection in `emit_indirect_call`:
- Check if `mir_func_type.return_type` is `MirStructType` or `MirTupleType` with >2 elements (mirrors `SretConversionPass::should_use_sret`)
- If sret needed: allocate shared sret slot before branch, pass `ptr sret(type) slot` as first arg in both thin/fat paths, call returns void, load result from slot after merge
- If not sret: original phi-based by-value return logic preserved

**Why**: Only affects MIR codegen (not legacy). Legacy path doesn't use SretConversionPass so it's self-consistent with by-value returns throughout.

**How to apply**: Any future changes to `SretConversionPass::should_use_sret` must be mirrored in `emit_indirect_call`'s sret detection logic.
